stem: A store manager receives a delivery of 2 boxes of lightbulbs. Each box contains 25 lightbulbs. The store manager tests all the lightbulbs and finds that 2 of them are defective. Based on these results, what can the store manager predict about the next delivery of lightbulbs?

options.label: F
options.text: A delivery of 3 boxes will contain 3 more defective lightbulbs than a delivery of 2 boxes.

options.label: G
options.text: A delivery of 4 boxes will contain 2 more defective lightbulbs than a delivery of 2 boxes.

options.label: H
options.text: A delivery of 5 boxes will contain 10 more defective lightbulbs than a delivery of 2 boxes.

options.label: J
options.text: A delivery of 6 boxes will contain 3 more defective lightbulbs than a delivery of 2 boxes.
